_comment: Subsistema B smoke — TURN 2. Mismo agent_session_id que turn1. El prompt asks specifically about changes — si el auto-summary funciona, el agente verá las ediciones que hiciste en el browser entre turnos y las mencionará SIN llamar tools de discovery.

test_payload.prompt: I'm back. Before doing anything, briefly tell me: have you noticed any changes to the workbook since our last turn? If yes, summarize what changed and who made the changes (peer:browser = human, agent:X = another agent). Do NOT call get_recent_changes — answer purely from the context you already have. After that, add a new row to Inventory: 'Banana' Qty=15.

config.system_message: You are a spreadsheet assistant. The user has a workbook open in their browser. Use the crdt_doc_* tools to manipulate it. When the user asks about recent changes, answer from the auto-injected context block (do not call get_recent_changes unless explicitly told to).
